programs.title: Underground Railroad: The Secret History
programs.desc: Retracing the steps of freedom seekers escaping on the Underground Railroad, archaeologists use high-tech to explore a Florida fort that was nearly erased from history.

programs.title: Underground Railroad: The Secret History
programs.desc: Archaeologists unearth the lost community of Quindaro, Kan., a long-forgotten abolitionist town that shielded Freedom Seekers from bounty hunters; in Illinois, experts use tech tools to explore a secret underground tunnel.

programs.title: Underground Railroad: The Secret History
programs.desc: Archaeologists uncover evidence of a Freedom Seeker community in the swampy marshlands between Virginia and North Carolina; in Maryland, experts investigate artifacts that may confirm the location of Harriet Tubman's childhood home.

programs.title: Underground Railroad: The Secret History
programs.desc: Underwater archaeologists search for the wreck of the USS Planter, a Civil War vessel seized by Freedom Seekers to escape the Confederacy; in Canada, experts use tech to uncover how Freedom Seekers lived once they made it to their new homeland.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programs.sub_title: The Wright Brothers: Cleared for Takeoff
programs.desc: An unassuming factory marks a revolutionary leap forward -- and upward -- in how humans travel; due to ongoing legal battles and innovative designs from their many competitors, these historic upstarts would soon be grounded.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programs.sub_title: Butler Island Plantation: The South's Dark Secret
programs.desc: The notorious owner of this Georgia plantation once held a sale of nearly 450 enslaved people; appalled at her husband's cruelty, the man's wife wrote and published a journal about the atrocities she witnessed.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programs.desc: An upstart mining town fuels the American war effort in both World Wars with its bountiful deposits of lead and zinc; the dusty remains of the mining efforts that put Picher on the map would condemn the city to abandonment years later.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programs.sub_title: Pullman, Chicago: The Town That Paralyzed the Nation
programs.desc: A railroad enterprise once built this company town for its workers to live in, but when thousands of employees went on strike, the military intervened; the history of the complex remains as relevant as ever.
